test_whisper_export_to_executorch: run the test_whisper_export_to_executorch method to export whisper-tiny to ExecuTorch via optimum-cli and verify transcription
test_test_whisper_transcription: run the _test_whisper_transcription method to transcribe audio from the librispeech dataset using a loaded ExecuTorch model
test_helper_whisper_transcription: run the _helper_whisper_transcription method to load a whisper-tiny model with a given recipe and test transcription
test_whisper_transcription: run the test_whisper_transcription method to test whisper-tiny transcription using the xnnpack recipe
test_whisper_large_v3_turbo_export_bfloa: run the test_whisper_large_v3_turbo_export_bfloat16 method to export whisper-large-v3-turbo with bfloat16 and verify file size
